methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 5 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Rhoman Aerospace is a seed-stage company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The comparable universe consists of 7 private companies in this space, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air, with no public market comps available for direct reference.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to this analysis. While 5 same-sector peers exist within Drones & Autonomous, none satisfy the filtering criteria for narrow peer selection—specifically, no datapoints meet the thresholds for same-stage valuation, adjacent-stage positioning, or similar valuation tier simultaneously. The analysis would require a minimum of 3 comparable companies meeting these criteria to generate a defensible peer median. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of business models and capital intensity across drone and autonomous vehicle subsectors.

Without a sufficiently robust peer-median result, this valuation cannot be triangulated to a supported range at this stage. The primary constraint is the sparsity of seed-stage comparable data within this nascent sector. Future valuation work on Rhoman Aerospace would benefit from either (i) identification of additional seed-stage peers with disclosed valuations, or (ii) deployment of alternative methods such as DCF or cost-of-capital approaches if internal financial projections become available. The early-stage and capital-intensive nature of autonomous systems development introduces substantial execution and market-timing uncertainty that complicates traditional comparables-based approaches.
